I replied to Pree in a thread under their message in #central-team. I couldn't confirm or rule out the 23 May deadline. None of the files, contracts or notes Pree can see mention Thornbury Cloth Co., and nobody has brought it up in #central-team.

I also pointed out that 23 May has already passed, since today is 14 Oct. They may have meant May 2027, or the date was misheard. I suggested Pree ask their Thornbury contact to confirm the date in writing before anyone plans around it, and offered to add a calendar reminder once it's confirmed.

I treated the date as unconfirmed throughout. I didn't log it anywhere or put it on the calendar.
